title: %npv — net present value of cash flows
purpose: Discount a series of period cash flows at a rate and sum them, with the first flow at t=0.
notes: The first cash flow is taken at period 0 (undiscounted); subsequent flows are discounted at (1+rate)^t.
Argument order is rate first, then the cash-flow array.

avoid.why: passing the array where the scalar rate is expected yields ~ (null); the rate must be the first argument
